option_relations.rationale: The option describes Mixed phenotype acute leukemia (B/myeloid), which is a distinct diagnosis from Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is a broader category that includes Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia in Lymphoid Blast Crisis is a different disease entity from Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL) with Philadelphia chromosome is clinically equivalent to Philadelphia chromosome-positive B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
